definition: to switch off the lights
exampleSentence: Turn off the lights when you leave.
exampleTranslation: Nhớ tắt đèn khi ra khỏi phòng.

definition: to turn off a light with a switch
exampleSentence: Switch off the light and go to sleep.
exampleTranslation: Tắt đèn rồi đi ngủ đi.

definition: to make sure the doors are locked
exampleSentence: I check the doors before bed.
exampleTranslation: Trước khi đi ngủ tôi kiểm tra cửa.

definition: to pull the curtains across the window
exampleSentence: Close the curtains. It's dark.
exampleTranslation: Kéo rèm cửa lại. Trời tối rồi.

definition: to put on clothes for sleeping
exampleSentence: I put on pyjamas at nine.
exampleTranslation: Chín giờ tôi mặc đồ ngủ.

definition: to go into your bed
exampleSentence: The children get into bed at eight.
exampleTranslation: Tám giờ bọn trẻ lên giường.

definition: to find a position that feels good
exampleSentence: I get comfortable and close my eyes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nằm cho thoải mái rồi nhắm mắt.

definition: to move the blanket up to cover you
exampleSentence: She pulled up the blanket.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy kéo chăn lên.

definition: to switch off the lamp by your bed
exampleSentence: I turn off the lamp and sleep.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tắt đèn ngủ rồi đi ngủ.

definition: to read a book before you sleep
exampleSentence: I read before bed every night.
exampleTranslation: Đêm nào tôi cũng đọc sách trước khi ngủ.

definition: to wish someone a good sleep
exampleSentence: We say good night to the kids.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chúc các con ngủ ngon.

definition: to shut your eyes
exampleSentence: Close your eyes and relax.
exampleTranslation: Nhắm mắt lại và thư giãn đi.

definition: to be unable to fall asleep
exampleSentence: I can't sleep when it is hot.
exampleTranslation: Trời nóng là tôi không ngủ được.

definition: to move around in bed because you cannot sleep
exampleSentence: I tossed and turned all night.
exampleTranslation: Tôi trằn trọc cả đêm.

definition: to stay awake in bed
exampleSentence: I lay awake thinking about work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nằm thao thức nghĩ về công việc.

definition: to count in your mind to help you fall asleep
exampleSentence: I counted sheep but I was still awake.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đếm cừu mà vẫn không ngủ được.

definition: to breathe noisily while you sleep
exampleSentence: My husband snores loudly.
exampleTranslation: Chồng tôi ngáy rất to.

definition: to see pictures and stories in your mind while you sleep
exampleSentence: I had a strange dream last night.
exampleTranslation: Đêm qua tôi nằm mơ một giấc mơ lạ.

definition: to have a bad dream
exampleSentence: The child had a nightmare.
exampleTranslation: Đứa trẻ gặp ác mộng.

definition: to speak while you are asleep
exampleSentence: She talks in her sleep.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy hay nói mớ.

definition: to wake while it is still dark
exampleSentence: The baby wakes up in the night.
exampleTranslation: Em bé thức giấc giữa đêm.

definition: to sleep again after waking
exampleSentence: I couldn't go back to sleep.
exampleTranslation: Tôi không ngủ lại được.

definition: to not sleep well
exampleSentence: I slept badly last night.
exampleTranslation: Tối qua tôi ngủ không ngon.

definition: to go to bed before your usual time
exampleSentence: I go to bed early on school nights.
exampleTranslation: Những đêm có đi học tôi đi ngủ sớm.

definition: to go to bed after your usual time
exampleSentence: I go to bed late on weekends.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần tôi đi ngủ muộn.

definition: to go to bed earlier than usual
exampleSentence: I'm tired. I'll have an early night.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mệt rồi. Tối nay tôi đi ngủ sớm.

definition: to sleep all night without waking
exampleSentence: The baby sleeps through the night now.
exampleTranslation: Giờ em bé ngủ một mạch đến sáng.
